items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And we even, take little Taft Smith, we had a different kind of approach to playing a solo.

ctx.x: Terrace, now they are playing shows. Now in the East there was this sort of network of theaters where all the bands were playing the Apollo and the Opera House and the Royal. And therefore there was a theatrical thing which developed which was different from the ballroom thing.
Yes, I guess so. But what I notice, even in solos there was a difference.
